evidence_limit: Request parameters, default settings and self-statements are not execution receipts. No fallback was reported this round.

reviews.scope: Independent estimand, identification and two-design audit; two primary papers
reviews.finding: Historical targetI cannot be changed by postprocessing; distinguish fixed-decoder policy loss from Bayes information and world do-effects. Temporal frames are not automatically paired counterfactuals. I is not a dose; descendants changing is not another intervention. Shared augmentation is not universally preferable. General axis mixing need not preserve the single-node intervention family.
reviews.decision: No new causal principle retained. At most one known-mechanism replication and one coordinate/metadata negative control; no experiment if required data/oracles are absent.

reviews.scope: Direct-prior and two-public-dataset audit, official page and loader source only
reviews.finding: vonKugelgen and Eastwood directly cover broad class-preserving/style-loss and structured shared-parameter claims. CITRIS small Pong lacks the required nondegenerate object-class label; seven-shape data has natural non-intervention shape changes. Public loader raw latent fields are not hidden just because training uses only targets. CausalTriplet verb/noun metadata is not universal dose/effect truth. Both data license and minimal small archive extraction remain unconfirmed.
reviews.decision: Original candidates0; neither dataset is currently verified ready for a small one-day experiment. No download or training.

root_additional_primary_check: AugSelf original explicitly includes supervised representation learning, so a generic supervised-versus-SSL distinction alone does not establish novelty.
final_static_review_corrections_applied: Calibrated measurement alone is not an ATE identification condition; pair with adequate randomization/exchangeability, support and consistency, or sufficiently known mechanisms.
Changing inputs by restoring/providing augmentation parameters, or changing the target coordinate label, does not automatically refute the original fixed-decoder policy-loss contrast.
Counterfactual pairs replace target mechanisms and preserve non-target exogenous noise, while descendants may change.
The mixed-axis linear relation is only a support constraint; the full pushed intervention distribution needs propagated mechanisms and noise.
